confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of UK regional pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July demand varies. The FX value came from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not verified by opening the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized UK regional city basis, benchmarked against regional English and Scottish cities such as Glasgow and Manchester, with a modest adjustment for Northern Ireland pricing.
